quest.title: Come Try Genius Invokation TCG!
quest.rewards_formatted: Fischl x1, Beginner Player Badge x1

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Meow, are you here to play Genius Invokation TCG? Well, that's for me to teach you the basic rules here!

talks.objective: Complete the Genius Invokation TCG Tutorial

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Congratulations, you've mastered the basics, meow.

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Now that you've learned the rules, let's have a duel, shall we?

talks.objective: Have a Genius Invokation TCG duel

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Oh, right! Take this Casket of Tomes. You can use it to edit your decks, meow.

dialogues.speaker: Prince
dialogues.text: Congratulations! You've become a qualified player. All the player functions are available to you now!
